# /crav1-read-environment

lane: cross-cutting | group: Start | starter: yes | stage: stable | since: 1.13.0 | prompts: 3
purpose: Read the host the user named.
use_when: The user names the host
reads: Reads the host the user named, non-prod resources on that host, prod-only resources for shape and connections when the user says yes, and `docs/environments/marks.md` when it exists. After that read, optional SQL metadata and storage structure only when the user says yes.
writes: Writes only confirmed lines appended to `docs/environments/marks.md` and `docs/environments/promotion.md`.
leaves alone: Leaves `docs/system`, `docs/architecture/spec.md`, feature specs, `docs/architecture/left-out.md`, and application code alone.
limits: does not guess the host. Naming production, prod, or live stops. One pass covers every non-prod environment. Pre-prod, shared-with-prod, and prod-only stay shape and connections until one yes. A no leaves prod-only in Skipped. Look-inside never opens production. A database with no clear environment is asked before it is opened. Missing access stops that look-inside. Never rows, blobs, or production data. Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud each have a reader. Any other host stops with no reader. A fact is seen in that environment. A prod-only line says `prod only`. A link only when the environment shows the connection. Does not start Specify, Plan, or Build. Names `/crav1-map-pipeline-environments` and does not run it. After `marks.md` lines are added, it asks once whether to run `/crav1-refresh-system-notes` and does not run that refresh from the question.
flow:
- When the user names a host, **`/crav1-read-environment`** reads every non-prod environment on that host in one pass.
- Examples: Azure, AWS, Google Cloud.
- It never reads production data.
- A line from that yes says `prod only`.
- It never reads a row or a blob.
- Production is never opened.
- The only file this command writes is `docs/environments/marks.md`, by appending a line the user confirmed.
- Never production data.
- Never rows, blobs, or production.
- Look-inside never opens production.
- Appends confirmed lines to `docs/environments/marks.md`.
- Does not write `docs/system`, `docs/architecture/spec.md`, a feature spec, or `docs/architecture/left-out.md`.
- System opens `../crav1-refresh-system-notes/references/handoff-read-environment.md`.
- Architecture and left-out open `../crav1-existing-to-specs/branches/repos-only/BRANCH.md` at **From /crav1-read-environment**.
- Match opens `../crav1-add-to-spec/references/handoffs-read-environment.md`.
- The rule is `docs/reference/open-skill-file.md`.
called_by: Called by the user.
runs by itself: Opens `/crav1-refresh-system-notes`, `/crav1-existing-to-specs`, and `/crav1-add-to-spec` for the append only after that section is confirmed, and does not start those commands.
you run next: /crav1-finalize-commit
first: `/crav1-read-environment Azure. List every non-prod environment. A prod-only resource is shape and connections only, after one yes. Do not guess the host.`
walkthrough: from-read-environment.md
